CUMULATIVE_ROW.algorithm: same mathematical row law, independently materialized matrix row; direct row identity and canonical order required

DIRECT_CDF.algorithm: normalize admissible row; Neumaier prefix cumulative; first positive outcome with u53<cumulative; final-bin rule

EXPONENTIAL_RACE.algorithm: score=-correctly_rounded_ln(u53)/normalized_weight; u53 zero gives +infinity; smallest score wins; exact score tie -> lower canonical index
EXPONENTIAL_RACE.draws: one per positive admissible outcome in canonical order

WALKER_ALIAS.build: q[i]=normalized_p[i]*n; sorted increasing small q<1 and large q>=1 queues; pop lowest from each; cutoff[small]=q[small], alias[small]=large; q[large]=(q[large]+q[small])-1; reinsert by increasing index; remaining cutoff=1 alias=self
WALKER_ALIAS.degenerate: still consumes two draws for one positive outcome
WALKER_ALIAS.sample: column=floor(u1*n); choose column iff u2<cutoff[column], otherwise alias[column]

constraint.BEFORE_TOKEN: remove BOS and EOS, condition remaining mass, then route primitive
constraint.forbidden_draws: no rejection, reuse, skip, or discarded draw

corpus.completion: after exactly requested token count; no RNG draw
corpus.requested_token_count: positive integer; zero is PROTOCOL_VETO before generation

length.at_64: successful structural token termination; zero extra draws

A_draw_order.fitted: productive-mixture; if productive prefix,stem,suffix; else rule-vs-exception then selected item
A_draw_order.synthetic: exception-vs-productive; if exception exception-item; else prefix,stem,suffix

m5.B_draw_order: same decisions, each selected by route B primitive and thus consumes that primitive's fixed draws
m5.attempts: exactly indices 0..1023; first proposal is attempt 0; exhaustion after invalid attempt 1023 -> GENERATION_FAILURE
m5.state_reset: logical proposal and local components reset; global draw_index persists
m5.validation: NFC scalar length 1..64 and nonempty; invalid/overlength consumes completed attempt draws then retries; no rollback

model_generation.M0: At every streaming decision use the frozen fitted or synthetic outcome row in canonical order.
model_generation.M1: Initialize order BOS values. At each decision use the longest available fitted row with frozen suffix fallback. Synthetic M1 puts EOS mass 0.15 last; at BOS multiply [.4,.3,.2,.1] by .85; otherwise glyph masses are [.45,.25,.075,.075] assigned respectively to successor modulo 4, same glyph, then the other glyphs in alphabet order, already totaling .85. After glyph emission shift context; EOS terminates.
model_generation.M2: Initialize empty suffix. Use longest retained fitted context else root. Synthetic M2 first constructs a glyph-only row: if a listed context has preferred glyph probability q, assign q to it and distribute 1-q among other glyphs proportional to their root weights; otherwise use root. Multiply glyph row by .84 and append EOS .16. Append emitted glyph and retain last four for lookup.
model_generation.M3_APPROX: Identical generation machine to M3_EXACT after the approximate fitted topology has been frozen; merge construction is fitting, not generation.
model_generation.M3_EXACT: Initialize canonical start state. Sample its explicit outcome row. Glyph transition enters the row's target; EOS terminates. BEFORE_TOKEN conditions EOS if a fitted start row contains it.
model_generation.M4: At token start sample pi, then sample that state's emission. EOS terminates without transition. After a glyph emission sample the current state's transition row and make the selected state current. At length 64 do not sample a transition.
model_generation.M5: Use the fully specified attempt and branch rules in m5. Fitted component/rule/exception sequences use canonical outcome order; synthetic parameters are explicit. Whole-token proposals contain no BOS/EOS/UNK sentinel.

numerical.comparison: u53 < boundary; equality selects following positive bin
numerical.final_bin: if cumulative roundoff leaves u53 unselected, select last positive admissible outcome
numerical.invalid_weight: nonfinite or negative -> NUMERICAL_FAILURE before draw
numerical.ln: correctly rounded binary64 natural logarithm of the exact binary64 input; u53=0 maps race score to +infinity
numerical.normalization: filter admissible outcomes preserving order; Neumaier sum Z; if Z>0 divide each retained weight by Z once in order

outcome_order.fitted_vocabulary: ordinary DEVELOPMENT glyphs ascending NFC UTF-8, then <UNK>, then <EOS>
outcome_order.m0_resolution: explicit registry [a,b,c,d,<EOS>] controls; EOS is last

CONTROL_GENERATE.draw_index: global monotonically increasing within corpus starting 0; increments after every consumed U53; never rolls back

parameters.transition_rule: given last glyph index i: next i+1 mod4=.45, i=.25, other two=.075 each; BOS uses [.4,.3,.2,.1] before EOS renormalization
given last glyph index i: next i+1 mod4=.45, i=.25, other two=.075 each; BOS uses [.4,.3,.2,.1] before EOS renormalization

serialization.final_newline: required after every token including last
serialization.logical: ordered sequence of nonempty already-NFC tokens; one token per logical line
serialization.normalization_operation: none; non-NFC logical input is invalid because generation emits only NFC vocabulary glyphs or U+FFFD
